pillar_reactions.evidence: Call ended at 00:18:19 during discovery. The rep explicitly deferred the presentation: "if I want to take you through how we can help you, then I guess that you also want to get all of the information without missing parts of it. So I would say let's just put something in the calendar for Friday."
Nutrition was covered in discovery only — current intake, no tracking, no eating window, force-feeding to gain weight. No protocol was described.

Never reached. Notable that accountability is what he described wanting in his opening answer — "I find it a little bit harder to execute without someone to tell you you need to do that and this and that" — so the pillar is pre-sold going into the rescheduled call.

anchors.raw: found out to the YouTube channel of Trevor's. I buy a kettle belt and I try it and I find it awesome. So I want to have a little bit more information and some workouts that I can do.
anchors.note: Third prospect in this batch whose entry point is the free content and whose stated ask is narrow — 'more information and some workouts'. He has also already self-equipped with a kettlebell and a pull-up bar. No price expectation was ever stated, so the size of the anchor is unknown going into Saturday.

anchors.raw: I never liked the gym. That's why... it's very difficult to me, after the army, to get in shape and have a routine at the gym because I hate the gym, too many people, too many movements, too many hours in the gym
anchors.note: The cheapest obvious substitute is one he has actively rejected on experience, which removes the usual low-cost comparison and should support the price when it lands.
